description: This Java source file defines an abstract class EventBusDeviceManagementAdapter that integrates a DeviceManagementService with Vert.x event bus messaging. It handles device management operations like create, get, update, and delete, providing methods to process each request type, including span tracing and error handling.

classes.name: EventBusDeviceManagementAdapter
classes.description: An abstract adapter class that connects device management requests received via Vert.x event bus to the underlying DeviceManagementService. Handles common processing of device operations with tracing and error management.

methods.name: processRequest
methods.description: Dispatches incoming event bus messages to the appropriate device operation handler based on the operation specified.

methods.name: processCustomDeviceMessage
methods.description: Handles custom or unsupported device management operations, defaulting to a Bad Request failure.

methods.name: deviceFromPayload
methods.description: Parses and converts the payload in the event bus message into a Device object, handling errors.

methods.name: fromPayload
methods.description: Converts the JSON payload of the message into a Device instance or throws an exception if invalid.

methods.name: processCreateRequest
methods.description: Handles device creation requests, including tracing, payload parsing, and invoking the create method on the service.

methods.name: processGetRequest
methods.description: Handles get device requests, including tracing, validation, and invoking the read method on the service.

methods.name: processUpdateRequest
methods.description: Handles update device requests, including payload parsing, validation, and invoking the update method.

methods.name: processDeleteRequest
methods.description: Handles delete device requests, including validation and invoking the delete method.
